name: assessment-design
title_zh: 按布鲁姆分类法设计带量规的评估方案
tagline_zh: 课程设计时最怕评估与目标脱节。这个 skill 读你的学习目标清单，用布鲁姆分类法对齐，再套 Nicol 七原则生。
tagline_en: Tired of assessments that don't match your goals? It reads your learning objectives, aligns them via Bloom's, and.
desc_en: Evidence-based assessment design with rubrics, feedback strategies, and formative checkpoints. Aligns each assessment to learning objectives using Bloom's taxonomy. Applies Nicol's 7 principles of good feedback practice. Reads from /learning-objectives manifest and extends it with assessment specs. (idstack)
why_zh: 不是模板堆砌，而是从目标清单出发反向推导评估规格，让量规、反馈策略和检查点都长在同一根目标茎上。
why_en: It doesn't just paste templates—it derives assessment specs backward from your objectives, so rubrics, feedback, and checkpoints.
limit_zh: 只认 /learning-objectives 清单格式，且只覆盖课程设计阶段；不生成试题、不批改作业。
limit_en: Only reads /learning-objectives manifest format; covers course design only—no item generation, no grading. Missing or malformed manifest aborts.
